observations: Photo 0 shows a black digital keyboard on a stand in a shop or storage area. The keyboard has 61 keys, white and black, with a slim profile. The stand is black and appears worn, with a small hole near the bottom. The background includes a person in red, purple baskets, and boxes labeled 'DU WANG'.

Photo 1 shows a close-up of the right side of the keyboard. The brand name 'Portable Grand NP-30' is visible in cursive script on the top panel. The keyboard has a speaker grille on the right side. The keys appear clean, and the casing is black with some minor scuffs.
The watermark 'DON LARGE GLOBAL POSTED ON JIJI' is present on both photos.
